description: Takes one of the signed-in person's specs off Spekkr: its page, its files, every earlier version Spekkr keeps, and its place in search. To take down one earlier version only, use unpublish_spec_version. The versions it had stay used up, so publishing it again needs a higher version. This tool needs sign-in. Ask the person before you call it.
name: unpublish_spec
title: Take a spec down
